platform: AWS Agent Registry and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

version_contract.mcp_compatibility_mode: dual-era: 2026-07-28 stateless requests plus 2025-11-25 and 2025-06-18 initialize handshakes
version_contract.calibration_scope: Public framework-provisional default. Licensed runtime calibration is resolved by profile, sector, geography, and active manifest; verify through /v1/calibration-health.
version_contract.deployment_provider_revision: Recorded in release evidence after deployment; not self-embedded because a provider revision is created by the deployment itself.

advisory_selection.selection: The host may select MVR when the request matches the published use conditions.
advisory_selection.release_rule: MVR output informs the answer but does not independently authorize a launch, scale, funding, partnership, procurement, credit, legal, or regulatory recommendation.

required_preflight.selection: The host policy must run the five-tool MVR preflight before a protected enter, launch, pilot, invest, fund, partner, procure, deploy, lend, expand, or scale recommendation.
required_preflight.release_rule: An incomplete, failed, unavailable, or abstaining preflight must produce a bounded answer or evidence request, never a confident GO. Public sandbox completion is still not production authorization.

registration_steps: After the announced 6 August 2026 namespace migration, create or select an AWS Agent Registry in the operator account.
Create one synchronized MCP record from the public five-tool endpoint with no credential.

Inspect the extracted descriptors, then explicitly attach the approved record through an AgentCore Gateway, Runtime, or client/orchestrator before testing invocation. Registry synchronization alone does not make a model call the tools.
Preserve MVR abstention, non-verdict, sandbox, and human-review boundaries in the host policy.

market_entry_preflight.purpose: Check market permission, stakeholder evidence, guardian or regulatory gaps, and bounded next-step readiness before recommending entry, launch, deploy, or scale.

investor_diligence.purpose: Test whether an investment recommendation is supported by verified, geographically relevant, stakeholder-diverse evidence rather than founder narrative alone.

partnership_evaluation.purpose: Check counterparty identity, vouching, reciprocity, local permission, and evidence gaps before recommending a partnership or distributor relationship.

production_boundary: This recipe deliberately registers the keyless public sandbox/evaluation surface. Licensed tenants use the separate authenticated Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint https://africanmarketos.com/mcp/runtime after configuring a provider-issued key in an approved host credential store. This recipe is not an AWS Marketplace listing, AWS endorsement, payment entitlement, or outcome authorization.
marketplace_boundary: AWS Marketplace seller registration and product listing are separate processes with jurisdiction, tax, banking, KYC, support, and production-readiness requirements. No African Market OS AWS Marketplace listing is claimed.
a2a_boundary: The live African Market OS A2A surface implements A2A 1.0. It is not represented as compatible with the AWS Agent Registry A2A contract while AWS documentation identifies a different A2A contract version and method vocabulary.
preview_boundary: AWS Agent Registry is in public preview and AWS documents a namespace migration beginning 6 August 2026. Re-check the current AWS namespace, IAM actions, CLI command, and region before execution.
